latestVersion.changelog:
Cemetery Video — 1.0.0

- Initial release of Cemetery Video skill.
- Provides video tour and educational video services for cemeteries, memorial parks, and burial grounds.
- Supports pre-planning conversations by showcasing grounds, memorial options, and burial choices through short clips.
- Helps families understand end-of-life planning decisions before time of need.
- Targets traditional burial, green burial, cremation gardens, veteran sections, and estate plots.
